name: Isofunctional Molecules Benchmark
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate prediction methods for identifying isofunctional molecules, measuring algorithm performance on isofunctionality prediction tasks.
reputation: A domain-specific benchmark used in cheminformatics/bioinformatics research; adoption is modest and primarily by specialist groups working on molecular function prediction.
notes: Domain-specific, non-LLM benchmark that requires molecular representations; potential dataset bias and limited public scale in some splits; results depend strongly on chosen molecular descriptors/representations.
